_functions: api/vehicles.ts declares `export const config = { runtime: 'edge' }` itself, so it needs no entry here. It MUST live in api/ at the project root: Vercel only discovers functions under api/ or pages/api/, and a functions glob pointing anywhere else is the documented 'Incorrect Function Glob Pattern' error. It sat in web/api/ until 2026-09-17, where it was never deployed at all.
_env: Set OTD_API_KEY in the Vercel project to enable live bus positions. Without it /api/vehicles answers 200 with an `unconfigured` body and the app runs on deterministic replay, which is the scope-locked default: no live provider is ever required.
